en.headline: Organ donation register reaches record 425000 but more than 2000 still waiting
en.dek: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said the figure is under 6 per cent of the population and urged more residents to register as over 2000 patients await transplants.
body: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said on Saturday that the Centralised Organ Donation Register had reached a record of more than 425000 people by the end of last year.

Speaking at the opening of an organ donation promotion event at Hong Kong Children’s Hospital, Lo noted that the number still represented less than 6 per cent of Hong Kong’s population of about 7.5 million. More than 2000 patients remain on the waiting list for suitable organs.

He said last year 37 deceased donors provided organs that helped nearly 100 patients, with one donor on average assisting six to seven people. The surgeries included 58 kidney transplants, 29 liver transplants, 12 heart transplants and six lung transplants.

Lo encouraged residents who have not yet registered to do so and to tell their families of their wishes. He also referred to the recently passed legislation on advance medical directives, which allows people to record instructions about organ donation in advance.

zh.headline: 中央器官捐贈名冊破42.5萬人創新高 仍有逾2000人等候
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，登記人數不足全港人口百分之六，籲更多市民登記，目前仍有逾2000名病人等候合適器官。
body: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂周六表示，中央器官捐贈登記名冊至去年年底已有超過42.5萬人登記，創下歷史新高。
盧寵茂出席在香港兒童醫院舉行的器官捐贈推廣活動開幕儀式時指出，相比全港約750萬人口，登記人數只佔不足百分之六，仍有很大進步空間。目前全港正等候器官移植的病人超過2000人。
他說，去年共有37名遺體捐贈者，平均每一名可協助六至七名病人。相關手術包括58宗腎移植、29宗肝移植、12宗心臟移植及6宗肺移植，合共讓近百名病人受惠。
盧寵茂呼籲尚未登記的市民盡早登記，並將意願告知家人。他亦提到早前通過的預設醫療指示法例，讓市民可預先就器官捐贈作出指示，為等候中的病人帶來希望。
